HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
